## What changed

- **`lat check mode` no longer flags tables in reference documents.** A table
  was being read as a second paragraph of narrative prose, which is banned in
  `reference/`. If you worked around this by converting tables to bullet lists,
  you can convert them back.
- **The conventions this tool writes into your `CLAUDE.md` now describe both
  ways to classify a document.** Put it in a mode directory, or declare the mode
  in its own frontmatter. Both are checked the same way. The old text said a
  document outside a mode directory was unchecked, which was not true.
- **Two new warnings in those conventions.** Classifying a document does not
  make it pass — a mixed document has to be split first. And `explanation` is
  not a safe default, because it bans imperative commands.

## Upgrading

```
npm i -g --prefix ~/.local/lat https://github.com/PlebeianTech/lat.md/releases/latest/download/lat.md-latest.tgz
```
